description: This is a main package for a command-line tool that handles internationalization of documentation files. It supports operations such as translating documentation files between languages, leveraging a translation memory, and possibly processing files in parallel. The code includes functions for processing either individual documentation files or segments within files, with options for filtering and skipping unchanged files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the CLI tool, parses flags, initializes components, and orchestrates processing of documentation files either in 'doc' or 'segment' mode, supporting parallel execution.

methods.name: runDocSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of files sequentially, translating and skipping as needed, updating processed and skipped counts.

methods.name: runDocParallel
methods.description: Processes a list of files in parallel using multiple goroutines, managing job distribution, handling errors, and collecting results.

methods.name: runSegmentSequential
methods.description: Processes a list of files sequentially at segment level, performing translation of segments within files.

methods.name: resolveRelPath
methods.description: Computes the relative path of a file with respect to the documentation root, used for logging and identification.

methods.name: filterDocQueue
methods.description: Filters out documentation files that are up-to-date and do not require re-translation based on hash comparison, returning the list of files to process.
